subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Works collaboratively and co-operatively to a set of classroom rules: listens to instructions, shares resources, ideas and space, waits for turn

show.line: In class we listen, share, take turns and put up our hand!

hints: Rules keep everyone safe and happy.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I want to talk in class.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I must put up my hand.

parent_line: Knows class rules: listen, share, take turns and put up a hand.
